findings.title: Request logs no longer include trace IDs
findings.body: The previous `logRequest` implementation explicitly added `traceID` from the request context to `logParams` when one was available. Moving the plugin/request attributes into `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` does not preserve that field: `instrumentContext` adds endpoint, plugin, datasource, and user attributes, but no trace ID. As a result, completed plugin-request logs can no longer be correlated with their traces, even though the metrics middleware still records trace exemplars.
